reason: A macOS DSH plugin that captures the current foreground window with a global shortcut and attaches the resulting image to the active Composer session. The README clearly documents its screenshot, permission, staging, and client-integration behavior.

summaries.zh: 在 macOS 上通过全局快捷键截取当前前台窗口，并将截图自动挂载到 DeepSeek Harness 的 Composer 会话中。
summaries.en: A macOS plugin that captures the current foreground window with a global shortcut and attaches the image to the active DeepSeek Harness Composer session.

capabilities: Captures the frontmost macOS window after a global double-Command shortcut
Requires macOS Screen Recording and Accessibility permissions
Stores the captured image temporarily and attaches it to the active DSH Composer session
Uses an SSE channel to notify the DSH client and can raise the DSH desktop window
Sends system notifications when capture fails or permissions are missing
